## Purpose

One `CR-nnn.yaml` per change: an engineering change proposal, change notice, deficiency, mishap, deviation or waiver, with the IDs it `affects`. When a change is `approved` or `implemented`, rule R10 requires every hazard it affects to carry a `reassessments` entry for it. Affected hazards are found through linked requirements, SSFs, mitigations (`HAZ-x:M1`), the hazard ID itself or configurations. If the reassessment outcome is `risk-increased` on a previously accepted hazard, a new acceptance dated on or after the reassessment is required, and only a named human review gives it (rule R13).

## Boundary diagram

![Figure 4 · Boundary diagram](assets/changes/figures/fig-4-boundary-diagram.svg)

| # | From | To | Crossing / interaction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Change control board | Change requests | engineering change proposals, deviations and waivers |
| 2 | Test events | Change requests | deficiencies and mishaps found in test (`kind: deficiency`, `mishap`) |
| 3 | Change requests | Impact decisions | `affects[]` names requirements, SSFs, mitigations, hazards or configurations |
| 4 | Change review | Hazard tracking system | a `reassessments` entry on every reopened hazard (R10) |
| 5 | Change review | Hazard analyses | reanalysis when a change adds a hazard or cause |
| 6 | Change review | Named human review | a new acceptance when risk increases on an accepted hazard |

**Explicitly excluded:** the configuration management system itself, approval of the change by the change control board, and the risk acceptance decision (reviews/ and element 7).

## Raising a change request

1. Add `CR-nnn.yaml` following [`change-request.schema.json`](https://github.com/jherrodthomas/Project-Susanoo/blob/main/pdac/schemas/change-request.schema.json) with status `draft` or `submitted`, the `kind`, and every ID it `affects`.
2. Before it is approved, add a `reassessments` entry citing it to every hazard this page lists as reopened, with the outcome.
3. Regenerate (`python3 tools/figures/changes_readme.py`, `python -m tools.pdac.report`) and run the full check list in [`CLAUDE.md`](https://github.com/jherrodthomas/Project-Susanoo/blob/main/CLAUDE.md).
4. Approving a change and re-accepting increased risk are human decisions; an AI may draft a change but never approves it or accepts risk (rule R13).
